facts.fact: Burundi's Council of Ministers adopted the draft law on access to public information on 10 June 2026, with corrections, and it is to go to both chambers of parliament before promulgation; the ministry says there is currently a legal vacuum on access to public information.

facts.fact: EU SEE (Hivos) reports that the Council of Ministers adopted the access to public information bill on 10 June 2026 and the Senate passed it unanimously on 29 September 2026, after the National Assembly debated it on 10 September.

Shikiriza reports that Burundi's National Assembly adopted the access to public information bill unanimously on 10 September 2026 and that, as of 28 September 2026, the President had not yet promulgated it.
